P1.outcome: SUBSTANCE CONFIRMED 126/126 on the direct rank measurement, but the FREEZE IS COMPROMISED. The measurement procedure was underspecified, my first instrument used a 400-sample gauge probe that cannot saturate when P-g > 400(C-1), and I corrected the instrument after seeing 21 mismatches. The bug accounts for exactly 21 = 3 configurations x 7 n-values, but changing a measurement after observing failure invalidates the freeze regardless of the diagnosis.

P2.claim: same law on untouched grid with the protocol fully specified
P2.outcome: FAILED, 118/360. The assumption that g = h_last+1 universally is false: g is activation dependent. ReLU is positively homogeneous, so (W1,W2)->(cW1,W2/c) adds h more exact symmetry directions, giving g = 2h+1. Confirmed 8/8 in a follow-up diagnostic: tanh gives h+1, ReLU gives 2h+1.

P3.outcome: FAILED, 2 of 48. The homogeneity component was a genuine prospective success: leaky_relu and abs were derived as homogeneous BEFORE measurement and both gave exactly 2h+1 in every cell. But two ELU cells at h=15 measured 17 against a predicted 16, off by exactly one, most plausibly a singular value near the 1e-9 rank tolerance. The frozen criterion was exactness, so it fails.

honest_status: An elementary and known relation, imperfectly confirmed under my own exactness standard, useful as a diagnostic and not as a discovery.
title: Three frozen attempts at an exact dimension law: one compromised, two failed
verdict: NO EXACT LAW CONFIRMED. The form is right, the integer count is not controllable to the standard I froze.
what_is_actually_true: d_free = max(0, P - g_arch - n(C-1)) where g_arch is the dimension of the architecture's exact function-preserving symmetry group. This is rank-nullity plus a correct symmetry count. Its components here are the softmax common mode (h_last+1, independent of C) and activation homogeneity (h per positively homogeneous hidden layer). Both are standard and neither is new: ReLU scaling symmetry and softmax shift invariance are textbook parameter symmetries.
why_it_still_mattered: It is the explanation for the entire navigation failure sequence. Every search in DISCOVERY-007 through 009 ran at n=600 with P-g=193, so d_free = 0 exactly and there was nothing to find. Those were structurally doomed, not unlucky. Knowing d_free before searching would have saved the whole branch, which is why it is retained as a mandatory pre-check.
